About

Stories on one side. Systems on the other.

I'm a Content Development & AI Strategist based in Mumbai. My work lives at the intersection of storytelling and systems.

I've led national campaigns, built AI agents from scratch, developed editorial frameworks for entertainment platforms, and created brand narratives that feel like movements. I come from theatre, subtitling, and film appreciation. I think in stories. I build in systems.
